description: Header file defining the Target class and related enums and methods for build target representation in a build system, including dependencies, output types, and configuration.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: Represents a build target with properties like type, dependencies, sources, and build configurations.

methods.name: GetStringForOutputType
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the output type enum.

methods.name: AsTarget
methods.description: Casts the Item to a Target pointer if applicable.

methods.name: OnResolved
methods.description: Performs actions after the target has been resolved.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from the target and its dependencies.

methods.name: GenerateFile
methods.description: Generates associated files for the target.

methods.name: has_metadata
methods.description: Checks if the target has metadata.

methods.name: has_generated_file
methods.description: Checks if the target has generated file metadata.

methods.name: GetDeps
methods.description: Returns an iterator range over dependencies of a specified type.

methods.name: SetToolchain
methods.description: Assigns a toolchain to the target.

methods.name: GetOutputsAsSourceFiles
methods.description: Computes the output source files for the target.

methods.name: GetOutputFilesForSource
methods.description: Computes output files for a given source file.
